$comment: An entry here is a DOCUMENTED RISK ACCEPTANCE, not a suppression. Each one
must state why no patched version can be adopted, what limits the exposure,
and when the acceptance expires. scripts/check-dependency-audit.mjs fails the
build when an entry expires, when an allowlisted advisory stops appearing
(stale entry must be deleted), or when any advisory outside this file reaches
HIGH or CRITICAL in the production tree.

2026-07-29 (N-0004/N-0005): the sharp and @huggingface/transformers acceptances were DELETED because the risk no longer exists — the dependency was removed from the runtime tree entirely (now an optional peer). npm audit --omit=dev reports 0 vulnerabilities. An empty list is the correct state: nothing is being waived.
